title: Normalized tower projective-line splittings and their forward base-change square
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, an arbitrary scheme S on which l is invertible, and a Presentation p of the actual coefficient-tower operations and tower Kummer classes [def-sp-tower-p1-adjunction-data, det-sp-tower-classes]. There exists KernelSplittingData k [def-sp-tower-p1-kernel-scalar-data], with the specified coefficient and roots pullback maps, unit/Chern splitting at q and both projections, and traceQ = p.trace. For both a : Bool the forward square pull(q)(k.splittingQ.hom) followed by k.exchange(a) equals k.sumComparison followed by k.splittingProjection(a). The canonical sourceUnitAt map for p_a Delta = id on the coefficient unit is an isomorphism. This asserts neither finite normalization nor the diagonal scalar identities.

source.place: Reduction of the triangle identities, trace base change

proof.text: Write $D_T=A_T(1)[2]\oplus A_T$ and let $s_r:D_T\xrightarrow{\sim}Rr_{*,\bullet}A_{\mathbf P^1_T}(1)[2]$ be the twisted form of the unit/Chern splitting of [det-sp-tower-classes](4); its second projection after inversion is $t_r$. Fix $i$ and put $j=3-i$. Regard $p_i$ as the base change of $q$ by $q$, with other edge $p_j$. The proper exchange and twist identifications give an isomorphism $E_i:q_\bullet^*Rq_{*,\bullet}A_P(1)[2]\to Rp_{i*,\bullet}A_W(1)[2]$ by [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons], applied to $M=A_P$ with witnesses $(B_n)_P[0]$. The hyperplane pulls back by $p_j$ to the relative hyperplane for $p_i$: on the two projective charts, pullback sends the basis $e_a$ to $1\otimes e_a$ and its transition $(x_a/x_b)$ to the same ratio. This uses precisely the gluing definition [def-pc-projective-space-twist], on affine base opens and then its compatible global gluing. Apply [lem-sp-tower-chern-pullback] to that line bundle and $p_j$: it identifies the actual pulled-back tower Chern morphism with the relative hyperplane Chern morphism.

source.place: Base change of the projective-line trace: hyperplane component

proof.text:
Here is the adjunction calculation comparing the two components, before any level evaluation. Denote the square's pullback/direct-image adjunctions by $L\dashv R$ and $L'\dashv R'$, its horizontal pullbacks by $v,w$, and identify $L'v=wL$ by the canonical compositor. By [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], its specified exchange is the mate $E_Y=R'(w\varepsilon_Y)\eta'_{vRY}$. For $a:X\to RY$, naturality of $\eta'$ gives
$$E_Yv(a)=R'(w\varepsilon_Y)R'(L'v(a))\eta'_{vX}=R'(w(\varepsilon_YL(a)))\eta'_{vX}.$$
Thus the adjunct of $a$ is pulled back to the adjunct of $E_Yv(a)$. For the unit component the adjunct is the identity; for the Chern component it is the hyperplane Chern map, identified in step 1. Twists and shifts use the specified tensor comparisons from the same system calculus. The two component equations give $E_iq_\bullet^*s_q=s_{p_i}d_i$, where $d_i:q_\bullet^*D_S\xrightarrow{\sim}D_P$ is the sum of the canonical twist and coefficient identifications.

source.place: Base change of trace: unit and Chern adjuncts

proof.text: The sourceUnitAt word is the direct-image composition isomorphism for p_a Delta = id; its inverse comes from the identity and composition comparisons of the normalized derived adjunctions.

lean.statement:
theorem towerP1KernelSplittingBaseChange (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (p : Presentation l E S hS) :
    ∃ k : KernelSplittingData l E p,
      (∀ a : Bool, (SpTowerShriek.pull l E p.classes.base
        (p.operations.geometry (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).map k.splittingQ.hom ≫
          k.exchange l E a = k.sumComparison l E ≫ (k.splittingProjection a).hom) ∧
      (∀ a : Bool, IsIso (p.sourceUnitAt l E a
        (unit (ProjectiveLine S) (Arings l E (ProjectiveLine S)))))
